lead.why: A new furnace job, and a lead that waits a day usually calls someone else.

waiting.subject: Quote for a new furnace
waiting.gist: Wants a quote to replace a 20 year old furnace
waiting.short: Jenna found you on the neighborhood group. Her furnace is 20 years old and struggled last winter. She asks for a quote and a visit next week, mornings are best.
waiting.reply:
Hi Jenna,

Thanks for reaching out. We’d be glad to take a look and give you a quote. Could we come by [Tuesday at 9am]? The visit takes about an hour and there’s no charge.

Dave
Buckeye Comfort Heating & Air

waiting.subject: AC making a grinding noise again
waiting.gist: Wants a tech out before the weekend
waiting.short: Mike’s AC is making the grinding noise again, three weeks after the repair. He asks for someone before Saturday and mentions it’s still under the repair warranty.
waiting.reply:
Hi Mike,

Sorry the noise is back. That repair is covered, so there’s no charge. Can a tech stop by [Friday between 1 and 3]?

Dave

waiting.subject: Maintenance plan for our two offices
waiting.gist: Asks for a yearly plan for two offices
waiting.short: Oakridge Dental wants a yearly maintenance plan covering both offices, with priority service. Dr. Shah asks what it would cost and whether you can start in October.

waiting.subject: Backordered condenser, pick a substitute
waiting.gist: Needs your pick by noon to ship today
waiting.short: The condenser for the Hartwell install is backordered until mid October. Tom offers two substitutes in stock and needs your pick by noon to ship today.

waiting.subject: Can we move Thursday’s tune-up?
waiting.gist: Asks to move Thursday’s visit to Friday
waiting.short: Linda has a doctor’s appointment Thursday and asks if the fall tune-up can move to Friday, any time after 10.
waiting.reply:
Hi Linda,

No problem. We’ve moved you to [Friday at 11am]. See you then.

Dave
